C208.notes: SER EU-TR-001. Photo confirmed · user shorthand 2011. Value side crescent+star · big 10 · KURUŞ · 2011 · Rumi-style border. Everyday Turkish small change — çay / dolmuş / bakkal. Country #35 — first Turkey / first Middle East–Anatolia. Sole Turkey · SER EU-TR-001. Turkey flips now 1.
C208.story: A 2011 10 kuruş from Turkey. The obverse shows Atatürk portrait and state legend; the reverse shows crescent and star; large 10, KURUŞ, date, Rumi-style border. Struck in nickel-brass.
